notes.text: Codification Section, Pub. L. 100–228, § 2, Dec. 31, 1987, 101 Stat. 1556, which set out congressional findings and policy, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
Short TitlePub. L. 100–228, § 1, Dec. 31, 1987, 101 Stat. 1556, provided that Pub. L. 100–228, enacting this subchapter, could be cited as the “Seminole Indian Land Claims Settlement Act of 1987”.
